concerns.text: T011 is tagged '[P1] [US1]' yet is ordered in Phase 2 after P2/P3 tasks (T005–T010) and consumes their outputs (lomo_validation.json, sensitivity_analysis.json, feature_significance.json, vif_resolution.json). A P1/US1-tagged task cannot ship within the US1 block (T001–T004) as the spec-kit independently-shippable-unit rule implies; re-tag it (e.g., US2/US3 aggregation) or move the US1-consumable portion (pre_check/power_analysis merge) so the story grouping matches the dependency order.

T004's power analysis (FR-014, 'before model training') is correctly ordered before T006, but its result is never consumed downstream: T006 trains all three model families unconditionally and no task reads reports/power_analysis.json to alter model selection. From an ordering standpoint this is a produced artifact with no consumer task — either wire T006 to read it or note the degradation path explicitly in T006's implementation.
